response.sql:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink AS orderslink,
    o.ordertune AS order_type,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) AS average_rebate,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS average_relative_gap
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rebate) AS average_group_rebate
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  g.orderslink,
  g.order_type,
  g.average_rebate,
  g.average_relative_gap,
  g.average_rebate - b.average_group_rebate AS excess_over_baseline
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE g.average_rebate > b.average_group_rebate
ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A relative gap with a zero fee rate is undefined, so those rows are excluded from that group's AVG via NULLIF; other rows in the group still contribute.
